focus: Reframe the ecommerce evaluation project around a canonical evidence-first Inspection Report generated from any public ecommerce URL.
reason_generation_started: The operator clarified that the primary deliverable is no longer an executive report. The project must separate inspection from interpretation and make the Inspection Report the authoritative source for downstream artifacts.
primary_deliverable: Structured ecommerce Inspection Report with one-page Inspection Dashboard, crawl health, endpoint discovery, catalog/browse graph, DS1-DS4 datasets, objective evidence, confidence indicators, and explicit limitations.
downstream_artifact_rule: Executive reports, competitor reports, consulting proposals, regression tests, benchmark studies, presentations, and customer-facing documents must consume the Inspection Report instead of re-inspecting the website.
required_next_design_outputs: DS3 search plus facet dataset contract
validation strategy update for inspection completeness and downstream reuse
